---
title: Google Group Demo
---

# Google Group

This runbook creates a Google group with the `<GoogleGroup>` block, and adds you to it. A group like this makes a good address for something many people need to receive mail for, such as the root user of a new AWS account.

You need to be a Google Workspace or Cloud Identity administrator who can create groups, and the Cloud Identity API must be enabled in the Google Cloud project you pick when you sign in.

## Step 1: Choose the group

<Inputs id="group">
```yaml
variables:
  - name: GroupEmail
    type: string
    description: The new group's email address, such as aws-prod-root@example.com
    validations: "required"
  - name: GroupName
    type: string
    description: The group's name, as people see it
    default: AWS prod root
  - name: YourEmail
    type: string
    description: Your email address, to add you as a member
    validations: "required"
```
</Inputs>

## Step 2: Sign in to Google

Sign in as an administrator. Signing in with Google needs the Groups Settings scope too, because this runbook lets outside senders, such as AWS, email the group.

<GoogleAuth
  id="google-admin"
  title="Sign in as a Google Workspace administrator"
  defaultTab="oauth"
  scopes={[
    "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform",
    "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/apps.groups.settings",
    "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.email",
    "openid",
  ]}
/>

## Step 3: Create the group

You become the group's first owner. The block also adds the email address you entered as a member.

<GoogleGroup
  id="create-group"
  googleAuthId="google-admin"
  inputsId="group"
  email="{{ .inputs.GroupEmail }}"
  displayName="{{ .inputs.GroupName }}"
  groupDescription="Created by the Google Group demo runbook"
  members={["{{ .inputs.YourEmail }}"]}
  allowExternalSenders={true}
/>

## Step 4: Use the group

Later blocks read the group from the block's outputs.

<Command
  id="show-group"
  title="Show the new group"
  env={{
    GROUP_EMAIL: "{{ .outputs.create_group.GROUP_EMAIL }}",
    GROUP_NAME: "{{ .outputs.create_group.GROUP_NAME }}",
  }}
  command='echo "Group $GROUP_EMAIL is $GROUP_NAME"'
/>
